children: Kumar will lead hiring strategy across digital engineering, AI, data engineering and emerging technology practices

Brillio has elevated Harsha Kumar to Director, Talent Acquisition, where he will lead hiring strategy across digital engineering, artificial intelligence, data engineering and emerging technology practices.

In his new role, Kumar will focus on AI-led recruitment transformation, strategic workforce planning, leadership hiring, talent intelligence and developing scalable recruitment capabilities aligned with the company's business growth.

Prior to his elevation, Kumar served as Associate Director, Talent Acquisition at Brillio. Earlier, he led talent acquisition for India at Falabella and ITC Infotech, overseeing technology recruitment, leadership hiring and workforce expansion.

His previous experience also includes talent acquisition and human resources roles at Cognizant, Mindtree and Wipro Technologies. He brings expertise in recruitment analytics, sourcing strategy, employer branding, recruitment technology and large-scale hiring operations.
